volume.title: Red Priest
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: Red Priest means war. Although there isn't much direct description of war, it is the overlying theme of the whole volume. The war underlines the struggle of all the 'drowning' characters, such as Klein and Trissy. When Trissy finally falls into the mausoleum, when Amon puts on his monocle in front of Klein, readers can truly feel that the drowning people finally sank into the water, no matter how they struggled.
volume.synopsis: After became a demigod, Klein stepped on the ladder of the door of light in the depth of the Gray Fog and learned about the truth of the Transmigrators. Klein returned to Backlund in the identity of Dwayne Dantes. He temporarily moved his focus to finding the truth of the Great Smog of Backlund. Under the cover of Arianna's concealment, Klein killed Qonas Kilgor and Hvin Rambis. He learned about the royal family and Adam's plan by channeling their spirits. However, before he could do anything, Feysac Empire attacked Backlund and Oak Island. With the information from the Red Angel Evil Spirit, Klein learned about the intent of the current king, George Augustus III, to advance to the Sequence 0 Black Emperor. Klein, in order to digest his Sequence 4 Potion and advance to sequence 3 Scholar of Yore, used the Life's Cane to treat the innocent people who were injured in the war. This left the hospital lore of the Clown Angel. Klein went to the island in the Berserk Sea and consumed the Sequence 3 Potion. When he advanced to Scholar of Yore, the mysterious space above the gray fog, Sefirah Castle, appeared in the real world. Amon, Pallez and Mother Tree of Desire cast their eyes on it. George III used the wartime speech to hold his apotheosis ritual. While Klein used the ritual that was provided by Mr. Door through Trissy to enter the mausoleums, Hermes, Zaratul, Suah and others came to stop him. Klein summoned Reinette Tinekerr and Death Consul Mr. Azik to help. Bernadette Gustav used the Magic Wishing Lamp to temporarily advance to Sequence 1 Knowledge Emperor to fight against William Augustus I. Trissy used the Yesterday Once More charm to restore the Primordial Demoness's ring and accepted her descent. In the end, due to chaos created by the fight of the Angels, the mausoleum collapsed. George III failed to advance and lost control. He died in the mausoleum that was destroyed by the lighting from the Lord of Storms. Klein, while fleeing, was intercepted by Zaratul who was waiting to ambush him. In order to escape, Klein entered Groselle's Travels and met Adam. He learned that all the plans were arranged by Adam behind the scenes. He was banished from the book and with the help of Arianna, Klein returned to the hotel in Backlund after performing several misdirections. There he was found by Amon through his lost marionette.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Audrey gave Klein psychotherapy.

Klein suspects but is not sure that a third transmigrant could be the Ancient Sun God. Klein discovers the names of the sequences in the path of the Red Priest Pathway Because of the blasphemy card he obtained. Xio was promoted to Interrogator. Crestet Cesimir came to Backlund to talk to Anthony Stevenson. Leonard joined the Tarot Club. Klein gave the Conspirer potion formula to Danitz. Klein made a deal with Maysanchez.
Fors and Xio explored the Abandoned Castle. Fors and Xio suffered corruption after exploring and leaving the castle. Xio joined the Tarot Club. Klein met Lucca Brewster for the first time.

Tarot Club 51st meeting. 'Adam is one step closer to being divine.' Pallez Zoroast and Leonard Mitchell discuss various topics, mainly the death of Medici. Klein and Haggis completed an arms deal at night. Klein met Alfred Hall for the first time. The Red Angel Evil Spirit in Ludwell's body secretly observed Klein.
Klein pays his debt with Reinette Tinekerr. Klein boarded the steam train and returned to the Northern Continent. Klein resolved the sacrifice incident on the train.

Klarman, creator of the Book of Secrets, makes his first physical appearance and it is revealed that he wanted to make the train sacrifice. Mandated Punishers found the trace of the disappearance of train staff and Primordial Moon's believers. Emlyn met Duke Olmer and he received a task to find members of the Rose School of Thought. Audrey Hall meets Escalante Oseleka again. Audrey reveals that she is a hypnotist and wants to move forward in The pathway, which Escalante accepts. Escalante also reveals that the name of sequence 5 for the spectator pathway is dreamwalker. Klein returned to Desi Bay by passenger ship and encountered the Black Emperor. Klein asked Nast Solomon about Emperor Roselle. With information from Bernadette Gustav, Cattleya confirms that Cielf June is a descendant of Roselle Gustav(Even Frank Lee can have a new assistant...🕊️). Emlyn White visits Utravsky to find a way to get revenge on Ernes Boyar. Audrey meets with Hvin Rambis as a councilor of the Psychology Alchemists.

Klein returned to Backlund. Patrick Bryan came to meet him, Klein discovers that Bryan is one of the Evernight Goddess's 'Blessed'. klein theorizes and receives information about Haiter, Artificial Death and Numinous Episcopate. Klein contacted Trissy.

Klein gave the Artificial Death's feather to Audrey. klein writes a letter to Azik Eggers. Klein visits Aaron Ceres and has a conversation with the newborn Will Auceptin, informing him that Ouroboros will not follow him due to the battle he had with Adam. Klein controls 50 rats with his Marionettist's powers. Klein fought with Flora Jacob who lost control. Amon appeared; he stole Flora's identity and killed her. Klein and Leonard planned to deal with Amon.
Tarot Club 52nd meeting. Klein prayed to the Evernight Goddess and obtained help from Arianna. Cattleya brought Cielf June to the Future. Klein, Qonas Kilgor and Amyrius Rieveldt played Texas Card.
Maric was promoted to Sequence 5 Wraith. Tarot Club 53rd meeting.

Emlyn and the Tarot Club carried out their plan against Ernes Boyar and sent him to the Harvest Church. Hazel Macht was promoted to Sequence 7 Cryptologist. Klein, Leonard, Pallez and Will destroyed Amon's avatars in Backlund. Audrey hypnotized Hazel and her family. Emlyn White was promoted to Sequence 5 Scarlet Scholar.
Leonard returned to the Blackthorn Security Company to use the Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem. Cattleya was promoted to Sequence 4 Mysticologist.

Sharron was promoted to Sequence 4 Puppet. Fors was promoted to Sequence 6 Scribe. Sherman was promoted to Sequence 7 Witch, and renamed to Shermane. Alger was 'officially promoted' to Sequence 6 Wind-blessed. Derrick was promoted to Sequence 5 Priest of Light. Audrey met Hvin Rambis and obtained the Dreamwalker potion formula.

Viscount Stratford and Katarina Pelle hunted Trissy. Shermane lost control and was killed by Xio. Xio asked Viscount Stratford about the truth of her father. Viscount Stratford's body exploded. Klein killed Qonas Kilgor with the help of Arianna. Arianna and three archbishops of the three major churches enter Ruins No. 1.
Tarot Club 67th meeting. Leonard was promoted to Sequence 5 Spirit Warlock. Trissy sent a letter to Klein and was terrified by Reinette.
Audrey hypnotized Fors and Xio. Hvin found Audrey's abnormality. Audrey used the Fate Siphon to siphon her and Hvin's fate. Klein killed Hvin with the help of Arianna.
The attack by the Sanguines and the Temperance faction on the Desire faction of Rose School of Thought failed.
Audrey was promoted to Sequence 5 Dreamwalker.
Klein, Leonard, and Audrey entered the Groselle's Travels.
Tarot Club 68th meeting.
Feysac's airship attacked Backlund. Feysac Empire Navy attacked Pritz Harbor. George Augustus III declared war on Feysac. Klein met the Red Angel Evil Spirit and learned the truth of the war.
Feynapotter Kingdom and Church of the Earth Mother invaded Lenburg.
Tarot Club 69th meeting.
Klein captured Tracy and obtained her blood. Klein obtained the locations of the 9 mausoleums the Blood Emperor left behind from Katarina Pelle.

Colin, Lovia, Derrick, and the exploration team entered the Giant King's Court. Lovia called the honorific name of The True Creator. The exploration team saw the scene of the establishment of Rose Redemption. The exploration team saw the ocean for the first time.
Frank was promoted to Sequence 5 Druid. Frank sent the mushroom's third prototype to Klein. Tarot Club 71st meeting.
On the Blood Moon night, Trissy prayed to Mr. Door. She asked him the ways to enter the nine secret mausoleums.
Alger was chosen with others to be promoted by his Church to Sequence 5. The City of Silver received Frank's mushroom. Klein was promoted to Sequence 3 Scholar of Yore.
Alger was 'officially promoted' to Sequence 5 Ocean Songster on Pasu Island, his Church Headquarters. In the morning, Audrey learned that George Augustus III would deliver a speech on Saturday.
Klein collected the Beyonder blood of 22 different pathways. Klein summoned 0-08 and orchestrated George III.
Main article: George III's Apotheosis Ritual. Klein met Amon at a hotel in the Backlund Bridge area.
